scope: all registered inputs, end-to-end, cold serial, verified numerical success, separate path and time tracks
test_exposure: Previously measured with baselines. Frozen candidate gets one prospectively declared test matrix. No changes based on its test scores.
comparison: Full per-track legal success count. Cost differences on the same successful (problem, replica seed) pairs against each existing baseline. Report scene-cluster uncertainty. No combining metrics or conditional means into a single score.
ablation: All 60 dev problems, minimum_time, replica 0, only clock proposals disabled. Other proposal RNG streams are independently paired.
